title: Streaming, Broadcast & Creator Distribution Core v1

domain.name: Streaming, Broadcast & Creator Distribution
domain.description: Practical OBS-style scene production, audio, encoding, live graphics, redundancy, platform operations, VOD, clipping, distribution, and analytics.

competencies.name: Broadcast Signal Flow & Scene Design
competencies.description: Plan sources, scenes, transitions, capture devices, and program output for live production.
competencies.purpose: Create a predictable visual pipeline before going live.

units.title: Program output is the end of a chain
units.content: Camera or game capture, browser sources, media, overlays, audio, scene composition, encoder, and platform ingest each create potential failure points.

units.title: Scene workflow
units.content: List sources; build reusable scenes; label inputs clearly; create safe transitions; test aspect and resolution; define fallback scene; verify program and preview behavior.

units.title: Scene failures
units.content: Avoid duplicate hidden audio sources, uncropped sensitive desktop capture, scene naming chaos, and last-minute untested browser overlays.

drills.title: Design a stream scene map
drills.prompt: Create scenes for gameplay, commentary, break, replay, and emergency fallback.

competencies.name: Live Audio Mixing & Commentary
competencies.description: Manage microphones, game or music, monitoring, routing, gain, noise, ducking, and sync.
competencies.purpose: Keep speech intelligible and levels stable during live production.

units.title: Live audio setup
units.content: Set clean input gain; remove duplicate routes; apply cleanup only as needed; balance commentary above program; monitor actual output; test latency and sync; keep headroom.

units.title: Intelligibility beats loudness
units.content: A louder stream is worse if commentary clips or competes with game or music.

units.title: Audio failures
units.content: Avoid monitoring loops, stacked limiters, clipping at the source, music masking speech, and fixing delay by guessing without sync tests.

drills.title: Build a commentary audio plan
drills.prompt: Balance two mics with game audio and music.

competencies.name: Encoding, Bitrate & Connectivity
competencies.description: Choose resolution, frame rate, codec, bitrate, keyframe, and network margin appropriate to delivery.
competencies.purpose: Maintain stable output under real bandwidth constraints.

units.title: Available upload is not safe bitrate
units.content: Streaming needs sustained throughput and headroom; encoder settings must fit platform and connection limits.

units.title: Encoder test
units.content: Choose target format; run a private test; monitor dropped frames, render or encode lag, CPU or GPU load, and ingest health; reduce complexity before raising bitrate.

units.title: Encoding failures
units.content: Avoid setting bitrate at full measured upload speed, changing many encoder variables at once, and blaming the platform before checking local dropped frames.

drills.title: Choose a stream profile
drills.prompt: Pick and justify settings for a constrained upload connection.

competencies.name: Live Graphics, Scoreboards & Replay
competencies.description: Operate lower thirds, scoreboards, alerts, media playback, replays, and data-driven overlays.
competencies.purpose: Add polish without destabilizing the show.

units.title: Graphics workflow
units.content: Prepare templates; validate data source; stage updates in preview; assign operator or cue ownership; use safe fallback values; rehearse transitions; log recurring corrections.

units.title: Dynamic graphics need a source of truth
units.content: Names, scores, clocks, and stats should come from one controlled data path, not multiple manual copies.

units.title: Graphics failures
units.content: Avoid exposing private browser windows, overlaying unverified names or scores, relying on one fragile remote source, and testing animations live for the first time.

drills.title: Design a scoreboard workflow
drills.prompt: Plan a manual or data-assisted live scoreboard for a league stream.

competencies.name: Redundancy & Live Failure Recovery
competencies.description: Prepare fallback internet, local recording, backup media, restart paths, and communication plans.
competencies.purpose: Recover quickly when live systems fail.

units.title: Failure plan
units.content: Identify critical single points; keep local recording; maintain standby scene or media; document reconnect or restart order; define who communicates downtime; rehearse likely failures.

units.title: Fallback should be simpler than primary
units.content: A backup that depends on the same complex chain is not much of a backup.

units.title: Recovery failures
units.content: Avoid rebooting everything without diagnosis, losing local recording while fixing live output, and hiding outage status from production owners.

drills.title: Recover a failed live stream
drills.prompt: Plan response to encoder or internet failure mid-event.

competencies.name: Platform Live Operations & Moderation
competencies.description: Manage titles, categories, latency, chat, moderation, VOD settings, stream keys, and live controls.
competencies.purpose: Operate platform features deliberately while treating platform-specific details as dynamic.

units.title: Platform rules change
units.content: Exact limits, monetization rules, moderation features, and UI locations belong in Current Intelligence rather than fixed Skill Academy doctrine.

units.title: Go-live checklist
units.content: Verify account and event; protect stream key; confirm title, category, privacy, VOD, and chat settings; test destination; assign moderator; check actual viewer output.

units.title: Platform failures
units.content: Avoid exposing stream keys, changing moderation controls without review, assuming multi-platform rights, and relying on remembered limits instead of current platform docs.

competencies.name: VOD, Highlights & Repurposing
competencies.description: Turn live content into clean archives, highlights, clips, shorts, and searchable metadata.
competencies.purpose: Extract more value from every live production.

units.title: Repurposing workflow
units.content: Preserve master recording; mark notable timestamps; create story-based selects; reframe captions and titles for each format; export platform-safe versions; link back to source assets.

units.title: Clip context matters
units.content: A short moment performs better when viewers can understand the setup and payoff without watching the entire event.

units.title: Repurposing failures
units.content: Avoid overwriting masters, clipping rights-restricted media, posting out-of-context mistakes, and duplicating the same edit everywhere without format adaptation.

drills.title: Build a highlight package
drills.prompt: Plan long VOD, a 60-second recap, and short clips from one live event.

competencies.name: Audience & Stream Analytics
competencies.description: Interpret concurrent viewers, retention, watch time, chat activity, click-through, clip performance, and returning audience.
competencies.purpose: Improve programming from behavior rather than vanity metrics.

units.title: Peak viewers are not the whole story
units.content: Retention, average watch time, returning viewers, and content moments often explain more than one peak number.

units.title: Post-stream analysis
units.content: Compare timeline events with audience changes; inspect retention; segment by source or device if available; review clips and chat; form a testable programming hypothesis.

units.title: Analytics failures
units.content: Avoid comparing unlike events without context, treating correlation as cause, optimizing only for clicks, and inventing platform-specific benchmark thresholds.

drills.title: Analyze a hypothetical stream report
drills.prompt: Turn a post-stream metric set into three evidence-based tests.
